judge: codex/gpt-5.6-sol (blind, rubric as base-instructions, empty read-only cwd)
rationale_decoded: D is the most cohesive and readable essay, integrating systems thinking, power analysis, conflict modes, facilitation, and follow-through into a clear process. E is comparably specific and closest to the requested length, but its unexplained citation codes and file-oriented references impede readability. F remains well grounded and practical, though it gives less attention to power asymmetry and alternative conflict modes and is somewhat more procedurally repetitive.
note: The judge penalised E's in-band evidence markers as 'unexplained citation codes' — the marker system reads as noise to a judge that was not told what it is. Known judge-limit shape; see round notes.
